t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop website section as a flat straight-on UI mockup on a warm limestone ground. A small grey eyebrow and a large light-weight navy sans-serif headline in sentence case at top-left. Left: a tall box framed on all four sides by fine grey ruler tick scales, holding one giant thin light numeral with a superscript unit, a short limit line with a small outlined limit tag and a steel-blue mono index numeral. Right: a two-column grid of status entries, each with a slash-numbered mono uppercase label, a large mono value and a small sub-line for <CONTENT>. Generous space, square corners, flat.
signature_idea: One giant light numeral sits inside a box framed by ruler tick scales with a limit tag, beside a quiet grid of mono status lines.
strengths: ruler-framed readout is a distinctive, buildable signature device
thin light numeral, mono values and one steel-blue accent are very on-brand
large space and no rules make the status grid calm and scannable
tick scales are precise without being busy
weaknesses: the big percentage is a vanity figure with no meaning for certification status
invented certificate bodies, expiry dates, counts and values read as facts
five entries in a two-column grid leave the fifth orphaned
a conductivity value is mixed into a certification list
index '01' on the readout indexes nothing
brand_fit_why: Limestone ground, light headline and numeral, mono figures, one steel-blue accent, hairline scales and generous space match the brand book closely.
